data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (99) 45 (54)
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 0.139m and recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 0.099m (a c.71% reduction relative to opening gross claims). The release is disclosed in the technical provisions movement note as "Change in estimates of prior year provisions (99) 45 (54)" and is explained in commentary as arising from very low claims activity and strong underwriting performance on the 2023 year of account - i.e. favourable claims development. The syndicate is a monoline property writer (Fire and other damage to property), so the movement predominantly affects the Property portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (99) 45 (54)

Claims activity has been very low during this calendar year with claims paid of GBP 0.1m contributing to net incurred losses being GBP 0.7m, well below expectations due to strong underwriting performance on the 2023 year of account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding prior year comparative). Prior year movement (gross) taken from Technical Provisions note row 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions (99) 45 (54)'. All amounts in the report are presented in GBP 000; converted to millions for this output. The syndicate is monoline (property). No specific named catastrophe events or quantified prior-year event line items disclosed in the reserves note. A small claims development triangle is present but only contains 2024 and 2023 columns; the explicit gross prior-year movement in the technical provisions note was used as primary source.
